issuerName: BETTERWARE DE MEXICO, S.A.P.I. DE C.V

segments.name: Betterware segment
segments.description: Sells home organization products through catalogs in Mexico and Latin America, distributed to end customers by its network of distributors and associates.
segments.evidence: The Betterware segment is divided into seven categories of the home organization: (i) Kitchen and food preservation, (ii) Home solutions, (iii) Bedroom, (iv) Bathroom, (v) Laundry & Cleaning (vi) Tech & mobility and (vii) wellness.

segments.name: Jafra segment
segments.description: Sells beauty and personal care products through promotional catalogues, distributed by its network of leaders and consultants in Mexico and the United States.
segments.evidence: The Jafra segment is divided into four categories of the beauty and personal care: (i) fragrance, (ii) color (cosmetics), (iii) skin care and (iv) toiletries.

revenueModel.text: Independent BWM distributors, associates, and Jafra leaders and consultants buy products from the Group for resale to end customers.
revenueModel.evidence: these products are sold to its main customers: BWM distributors and Jafra leaders and consultants.
